devServer.notes: Existing Next dev server was already responding before desktop work started.

sceneEngine.nextConfig: empty NextConfig object before desktop work
sceneEngine.typescriptConfig: single Next app tsconfig with strict mode and @/* path to app/_engine/*

scenePersistence: app/api/scenes/[id]/route.ts reads and writes project scenes under process.cwd()/projects/<project>/scenes/<scene>/scene.json
assetPersistence: app/api/upload/route.ts writes uploaded files under process.cwd()/public/assets/<type>
readOnlyRuntimeInputs: app/api/export/route.ts reads public assets/modules/fonts and app/_engine/export templates
app/_engine/lib/export-reachability.ts reads project scenes and public module manifests
filesystemSurfaces.packagingRisk: The current API and server-side helpers rely on process.cwd(); packaged Main Menu must run these paths against a writable workspace, not the macOS app bundle resources.

piAssetLoop.packageManager: npm package-lock plus bun script entrypoint

assetExtractionPipeline.packageManager: npm package-lock plus Python uv project

pathReferences: docs/scene-engine/00-overview.md references both helper app paths
helperApps.moveDecision: Deferred for this implementation pass because the helper apps have Makefile, README, Python path-derivation, and bun entrypoint references. Keeping them in place avoids a broken half-move while the desktop package milestone is implemented.

initialImplementationRoute.developmentRuntime: Electron loads the existing Next dev server, starting it only if the health check fails.
initialImplementationRoute.packagedRuntime: Build Next output: standalone, stage it as an Electron extraResource, seed public/projects into Electron userData, create runtime symlinks, and launch the standalone server with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE.
initialImplementationRoute.preloadBridge: Expose window.mainMenu.app.getInfo() through contextBridge and typed IPC.
